touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest

Reconstructed again 1950, thatch replaced by slates and detail considerably changed. U-plan coursed granite cottage group round sunk court, E and W houses single-storey and attic, N. block single-storey.

features.name: 7 The Terrace, Dunecht
features.documentedDateText: designed in Dunecht estate office 1923 and 1936
features.fullDescription: George Bennet Mitchell. Early 1900s. Picturesque row of standard Dunecht estate single-storey and attic cottages arranged as semi detached pairs with later shops at each end, set well back from the road. Built in squared rubble. Each cottage has a central timber and glazed porch with a bargeboarded gable and a pair of gabled dormer windows with bargeboarding. Shops designed in Dunecht estate office 1923 and 1936 by David Morris.
